notes.title: Rift World - Update
notes.content: This update adds the ability to change the player movement keys through custom key binding. Head to the Settings -> Controls Page to update your custom key bindings!

notes.title: Rift World - Hot Fix
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

This is a small patch that addresses the camera stuttering some players have been experiencing. Camera stutter should now be removed or reduced for players. Please let us know if any other issues arise while playing. We will do our best to correct the issues!

Kind Regards
-Nick
